name: check
title_zh: 问一句就知道会不会被拦的干跑命令试金石
tagline_zh: 怕误伤生产环境？先干跑一遍，不执行、不落地，只看 Anchorwatch 拦不拦。像试穿不买，专治手抖和心慌。
tagline_en: Worried a command might get blocked? Test it first without running it. Like a fitting room for shell.
desc_en: Dry-run a shell command against Anchorwatch rules without executing it. Use when the user asks "would Anchorwatch block X?" or wants to test a command safely.
why_zh: 把「会不会被拦」从猜变成查：它读规则、模拟执行路径，但不碰真实命令，给你一个零风险的预判答案。
why_en: Turns 'will this be blocked?' from guesswork into a lookup: reads rules, simulates the path, never touches the real command. A.
limit_zh: 只判断 Anchorwatch 规则集内的拦截，不覆盖其他安全工具；干跑结果不等于真实执行。
limit_en: Only evaluates Anchorwatch rule sets, not other security tools. Dry-run result ≠ actual execution; network side effects or races still need manual.
title_en: Dry-run a shell command against Anchorwatch rules, no.
